name: qfd_dv_s5_tapb

pin_regs.reason: the RTL registers every input at its pin (ot_qfd_xhead g_pin / ib_pin / f_q / tid_q / fi_q / lqp; ot_qfd_xs_tap E1 pin registers) and drives every output from a flop; flow pin registers would add unpriced cycles

reset_landing.reason: the RTL lands rst_n in two registered stages (qfd_dv_s5_rst2) at the face

safe_design_checklist.1_pins: PASS: ot_qfd_xs_tap registers its inputs (E1 pin registers) and launches hw from flops; cid HARD 1 register; lq_bad OR -> fault join is sticky status; rst_n 2-stage landing
safe_design_checklist.3_fanout: gate textbook_lint high_fanout (hw broadcast: one copy, the parent lands 4 column copies)
safe_design_checklist.4_depth: inherited ot_qfd_xs_tap STATIC_SCHEDULE 1 (closed in the heads cluster)
safe_design_checklist.5_storage: PASS: no indexed flop array > 2 kb (tap queue <= 2 entries)
safe_design_checklist.6_floorplan: pin-bound (util ~5%: 2.4k um2 std, 6.2k flops, 3.1k pins): hw 1,567 over the whole N face (5.3/um), hr+xt 1,503 over S (5.0/um) by pin_ranges; aspect 2:1; no macros
safe_design_checklist.8_schedule: HARD 1: cid (4 sid + c, static after SETID) +1 edge = 0 steady cycles; everything else as qfd_dv_heads
